verdict.rationale: Dynadot advertises free custom email on your own domain (dynadot-docs-16, also listed in llms.txt), which covers the email-on-domain part of the story. It also sells DV SSL certificates (dynadot-docs-15, dynadot-docs-31), but nothing shows SSL is free or bundled, so the 'costs nothing extra' promise is only half supported. Missing for 10: evidence that SSL is free or bundled, explicit email-forwarding documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
